notes.title: You're now a Docent
notes.text: We now guess your reaction right 66% of the time. Don't let it go to your head. Or ours. Painter 7 keeps getting your approval. It may be time to admit you have a favorite. You keep citing the light, with the color a close second. A person of principle. Next, try Art of Africa. Worst case, you'll have something new to pass on.

notes.title: An honest assessment
notes.text: Remember Baroque? Lately you've moved on to Impressionism. Baroque is taking it well. Show you yellows & golds and you melt a little. Your latest Love was Raffia Box. Bold choice. We respect it. Next, try Italian Renaissance. Worst case, you'll have something new to pass on.

notes.title: A note on your looking
notes.text: Impressionism is the movement you respond to most so far, across 15 works. The images you keep tend to be bright, cool, regardless of when they were made. Works made in United Kingdom stand out among the ones you keep. Next, try a little Ancient Greece; you haven't seen any yet.
